Walk 4 min (310 m) from Bundaran HI to Imam Bonjol, then:
Board 4C (Jiep - Bundaran Senayan) on the Bundaran Senayan 1 → TU Gas 2 side at Imam Bonjol, and alight at Tugu Proklamasi.
Walk 4 min (300 m) to Proklamasi.
Board the LRT Jakarta South Line towards Kelapa Gading at Proklamasi, and alight at Kelapa Gading.

About 65 minutes, one change, Rp8.500 total (Rp3.500 Transjakarta Metrotrans/Minitrans plus Rp5.000 LRT Jakarta, paid separately).

Nothing is closed: the journey comes back open and no active notice touches it. Don't miss the short walk between Tugu Proklamasi and Proklamasi — the bus and the LRT stop at different places, and it is not a free transfer.
